name: Unholy Night
source:
On December 24th, a blizzard left us stranded. Uncle Melvin's house was nearby and safer than a motel, but the moment I entered, something didn't feel right.

[From [url=https://endersonnobre.itch.io/unholy-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
12月24日，一场暴风雪让我们陷入困境。梅尔文叔叔的房子就在附近，比汽车旅馆更安全，但我一进去，就感觉有些不对劲。

[来自[url=https://endersonnobre.itch.io/unholy-night]Itch.io[/url]]
